name: verifiable-rpc-sdk
description: TypeScript verifier client for Ankr's verifiable RPC sidecar — Ed25519 signature verification + TDX attestation helper.
author: Web3 Technologies, Inc.

scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm run publish:dry-run && pnpm -r publish --provenance --no-git-checks
scripts.check:pack: rm -rf .pack && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' --filter '!./packages/test-support' pack --pack-destination .pack && for f in .pack/*.tgz; do publint --strict $f && attw $f --profile esm-only || exit 1; done
scripts.check:dup: jscpd packages/core/src packages/dstack-verify/src packages/ethers/src packages/viem/src packages/proxy/src --threshold 1.42
scripts.check:deps: depcruise packages/core/src packages/dstack-verify/src packages/ethers/src packages/viem/src packages/proxy/src
scripts.check:api: for c in packages/*/api-extractor*.json; do api-extractor run -c $c || exit 1; done
scripts.api:update: for c in packages/*/api-extractor*.json; do api-extractor run --local -c $c || exit 1; done
scripts.example:all: pnpm example:01-ethers-client && pnpm example:02-viem-client && pnpm example:03-vrpc-core-walkthrough && pnpm example:04-proxy
